text:
alex: Quick sync 1 ACME SI onboarding next week. Need a clear artifact handoff plan for SOC reports, penetration test exports, and the joint announcement timeline. Who takes what?

maria: Ill own SOC2 collection and redaction checklist. Will need ACMEs attestation contact for signature.

sam: I can handle pen-test artifacts and vuln-scan logs. Do we require raw scan JSON/exports or just the vendors summary PDFs?

alex: We prefer raw exports plus a signed summary PDF for traceability. Raw can be redacted for PII. Maria and Sam should align on redaction rules.

olivia: FYI partner SI has asked for presigned S3 uploads previously. Propose 7-day presign window and a staged path: s3://redwood-onboard/acme/{artifact_type}/.

ben: Agreed on staging. Also include an artifact naming convention, max file size limit, and a GPG fingerprint for file signing.

maria: Drafting checklist now. Quick question: does the marketplace require a separate one-page attestation beyond SOC2?

alex: Yes  marketplace wants a one-page attestation specifying SOC2 scope and pen-test scope; Legal will sign.

sam: ACME requested a joint announcement ~3 weeks after onboarding. Suggest internal freeze: redaction + QA by day 10. Can we meet that?

alex: Tentative timeline: ingest window day 0-7, redaction/QA day 8-12, legal attestation day 13-14, announcement day 21. OK?

olivia: I'll provision the presign role and write a short upload runbook with example CLI. Example for SI: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-onboard/acme/onboard/pen-test/scan1.json --expires-in 604800```

ben: Pen-test uploads should include a CSV of repo/hardening hashes and a mapping file describing scanned hosts so we can reproduce.

maria: Shared draft checklist: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboard-acme-checklist (editable).

devsec-bot: Reminder  verify artifacts adhere to customer-approved retention. Use retention key: acme-onboard-2026.

sam: Who is ACMEs primary contact for upload issues?

alex: Olivia, can you confirm?

olivia: Confirmed  jordan@acme-sis.com. I'll intro + attach checklist and upload instructions.

ben: Creating staging bucket + IAM now; will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

alex: Action items: Maria draft checklist, Sam prepare scan-export template, Ben build staging + IAM, Olivia intro to ACME. Reconvene in 4 days for status.

maria: Will have checklist draft by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Upload templates ready by EOD as well.

ben: Provisioning in progress, ETA ~4 hours.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post final timeline in #partnerships-ops after drafts are in.
